# GET /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issue_templates

Get available issue templates for a repository

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-371`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |

## Response

**200** — []*api.IssueTemplate

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `name` | string | template name |
| `about` | string | template description |
| `filename` | string | template file name |

- **404** — Repository not found

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | repo.GetIssueTemplates | controller | Call ParseTemplatesFromDefaultBranch; Add warning header if errors |
| 2 | [services](../modules/services.md) | issue.ParseTemplatesFromDefaultBranch | service | Get branch commit; Iterate template dir candidates; List entries; Unmarshal each template file |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Issue templates are parsed from multiple candidate directories in priority order | business_logic | Template dirs: ISSUE_TEMPLATE, .gitea/ISSUE_TEMPLATE, .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE, .gitlab/ISSUE_TEMPLATE |

### Error Paths

- **Repo is empty** → returns empty list → 200
